releasenotes: A topic's first and last post: the same post as IPS also when two posts share a second. Since 1.1.0 the plugin forced the topic's index for this query; where IPS reads another index or sorts, that could return the other of two posts written in the same second, and a member's last post in a large topic was slower than IPS's own plan. The plugin now only leaves out the date index of the whole forum, as for topic pages: IPS's own plan wherever the database would not use it, 0.6-1.2 s -> 1-2 ms where IPS walked it. Needs the post_date index as well.
